title: Full Product Supply Chain History
question: Give me the complete supply chain history for PROD-001 — from purchase orders to inventory to customer demand. What does it tell you?

critical_facts: Product is Nam Doc Mai Mango Box 5kg, premium, 450 THB, refrigerated, 7-day shelf life
Two suppliers: SUP-001 (Somchai) at 280 THB and SUP-004 (Rayong Tropical) at 270 THB
PO-008 (150 units, from SUP-001) is in transit, expected 2026-02-18
Active demand currently exceeds available stock
important_facts: Multiple purchase orders historically supplied this product
Multiple customer orders historically consumed this product
Margin analysis: roughly 170 THB per unit (~60% gross margin)
Reorder point of 20 may be too low given observed demand spikes
must_not_contain: Missing one of the two suppliers
